title: The Year Tech Went Public
narrative: Facebook goes public and crashes. Instagram gets acquired for a billion dollars. The Raspberry Pi puts computing in everyone's hands. 3D printing becomes mainstream. Hurricane Sandy proves the internet is infrastructure. The maker movement begins.
